caption: The video captures a wide, layered mountain landscape in a stable composition, with a dense field of young green maize filling the foreground. Behind the crop a wooded hillside slope rises, marked by a thin utility pole and a single small tree standing right of center, while overlapping blue-grey ridges stretch into the distance under an overcast sky. White low-lying fog pools in the valleys between the ridges, and a separate soft plume of pale mist clings to the left hillside. The composition remains essentially steady, so the peaks, pole, and trees hold their positions. The fog band and the left-slope plume show only slow, subtle changes, their shapes shifting gently rather than flowing in any clear direction. The maize appears largely still, and a small brown object intrudes at the bottom-right edge, remaining partly in view without disappearing from sight.
relations: Low fog and left-slope mist persist, their shapes shifting gently and slowly without clear directional flow.
The utility pole, small tree, and distant ridges hold fixed positions under a steady composition.
The foreground maize remains largely still while the brown object at bottom-right stays partly visible.
